svg.title: Light-emitting diode
svg.desc: Light-emitting diode, IEEE 315-1975 §8.5.1 semiconductor diode with §1.3.1 radiation arrows pointing away (Note 1.3B). Drawn exactly as D1 in the Schematex circuit exemplar (visual-eval/exemplars/circuit/ideal.svg, exemplar viewBox 1166 314 70 76); one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (anode) (24,8), end (cathode) (24,68).
